text: Skip to main content Find Help More In Help Interactive Tax Assistant Tools Report fraud Tax scams Identity theft Notices and letters Appeals Frequently asked questions Accessibility Contact your local IRS office Contact an international IRS office Tax topics Other languages Help with finding items in file listings File listings on IRS.gov can contain thousands of items. To help you find what you need our listings application allows you to search, filter and sort your results. All searches are done from the single “Find” box that appears on each listing page. Clicking on any column heading sorts the table by the content of that column. Clicking the same heading again reverses the sort order. Use the “Show per page” box to change the number of items displayed on each page. Find forms, instructions, and publications You can: Enter the product number in the Find box. TIP: Try entering just the number (for example "941" or "1040-X") and leave out words like "Form" or "Instructions," Enter a keyword from the title in the Find box (for example “interest” or “deduction”), or Enter a tax year or revision date in the Find box (for example “2022” or “Sep 2017”). After completing the “Find” box entry click the “Search” button. Find Internal Revenue Bulletins You can enter a year or bulletin number in the Find box (for example “2021” or “2021-38”). After completing the “Find” box entry click the “Search” button. Find written determinations or information letters You can: Enter a number in the Find box, Enter a UILC number in the Find box, or Enter a keyword from a subject in the Find box. After completing the “Find” box entry click the “Search” button. Find actions on decisions You can: Enter a number in the Find box, or Enter a keyword from the decision or issue in the Find box. After completing the “Find” box entry click the “Search” button. Find Chief Counsel notices You can: Enter a number in the Find box, or Enter a keyword from the subject in the Find box. After completing the “Find” box entry click the “Search” button. Find applicable federal rates You can: Enter a number in the Find box (for example 2022-01), or Enter a month, year, or both in the Find box (for example “Jan,” “2021,” or “Jan 2021”) After completing the “Find” box entry click the “Search” button.
